p1_b4.ocr: Additionally, the regional context is illustrated through the "Region of Community Mental Health Clinic," which identifies the geographical distribution of clinics participating in the survey. In the case of Regina Qu’Appelle, with an adult population of 218,783, the statistics indicate that a significant proportion of patients are experiencing treatment delays linked to the choice of surgeon, exemplifying a critical area for improvement.

p1_b5.ocr: At the time of the survey, clinics had varying levels of experience with ICBT, as denoted by the "# of months clinic used ICBT at time of survey." This information is vital for understanding how operational factors, such as the number of therapists trained in ICBT—totaling 40 across participating clinics—affect patient outcomes and service efficiency. The insights gleaned from this data can inform strategies aimed at enhancing clinic operations and ultimately improving patient care.
